assertions: An exact replay before restart returns the same receipt with replayed true, so no second receipt is issued.

A delivery retried after restart gets the same ack id as the delivery acknowledged before it, so the retry adds no second acknowledgement identity.
At the expiry instant after restart the receipt fails expired.
After a restart that drops v2, the v2 receipt fails unknown_key_version while the v3 receipt verifies.
